source.name: Aston Martin Aramco – Aston Martin Aramco turns to Eight Sleep to support competitive edge
source.quote: Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team announces a new partnership with Eight Sleep, the world's leading sleep technology company, focused on improving driver and team performance across the 2026 Formula One season.

note: New partnership announced 10 February 2026, focused on the 2026 season. No reported value.
